exactDeltas.before: Long-term ITT analyses did not show significant intervention effects. Per-protocol participation in eight sessions was associated with fewer internalizing problems.
exactDeltas.proposedAfter: No significant treatment-by-time effects were found for behavior or resilience. A post-hoc eight-session threshold was associated with less internalizing growth; in the fully adjusted model, the dose-by-time effect did not survive the multiple-testing correction.
exactDeltas.reason: Primary Results pp855–858 and Table5; distinguish the simpler dose analysis from the adjusted model.
